paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPEr-electric solid-state 207Pb NMR search for axion-like dark matter, mass 162-166 neV (Compton freq ~39.65 MHz). Primary result is EDM coupling |gd| < 9.5e-4 GeV^-2, converted by the authors to an oscillating neutron EDM amplitude d_n < 1.0e-21 e*cm (95% CL); emitted as a flat horizontal bound over the stated 162-166 neV mass range in e*cm. Paper also reports gradient coupling |gaNN| < 2.8e-1 GeV^-1 (AxionNeutron) - not emitted here. DM density inferred from stated rho_DM = 3.6e-42 GeV^4 (~0.4-0.47 GeV/cm^3).
